description: Monthly US trade trends with ONE trading partner — month-by-month imports and exports for a country, optionally narrowed to an HS commodity, to show seasonality and shifts. A country is required: an unfiltered monthly query spans every partner and the Census API cannot return it in time. For all-countries totals use census_imports / census_exports instead.

country.description: Country name in plain English (e.g., "Mexico"). Preferred — resolved for you. REQUIRED unless you pass country_code.

country_code.description: Census Schedule C country code (e.g. "5700" China, "2010" Mexico). NOT an ISO code. Prefer `country`. Satisfies the country requirement.

end_year.description: End year (e.g., "2024"). Optional — defaults to the last fully-published year (last calendar year; Census publishes on a lag).

hs_code.description: HS commodity code. Optional — omit for aggregate trade.

start_year.description: Start year (e.g., "2022"). Optional — defaults to the same year as end_year, i.e. a single year. Maximum span 3 years.

name: census_trade_trends

country.description: Resolved country name as Census reports it, or 'all' for all countries

country_code.description: Census country code or 'all' for all countries

hs_code.description: HS commodity code or 'all' for aggregate

balance_usd.description: Trade balance in USD for period

exports_usd.description: Export value in USD for period

imports_usd.description: Import value in USD for period

title: Census Trade Trends
